    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY):
        Rectangle(plate_size, plate_size)
    extrude(amount=plate_thickness)

    extrude(amount=boss_height)

        (hole_x, -hole_y, hole_br),
        (-hole_x, hole_y, hole_tl),

        with Locations((hx, hy, 0)):
            Cylinder(ream_d / 2, plate_thickness + 20, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

                   p.part.edges().filter_by(Axis.Z).sort_by(Axis.X)[-2:]

# --- dimensions (mm) ---
gear_diameter = 80.0          # outer diameter
gear_width = 34.2             # axial width
tooth_count = 10              # number of teeth
tooth_root_radius = 30.0      # root radius (tooth profile starts here)
tooth_tip_radius = gear_diameter / 2.0   # 40.0 tip radius
tooth_root_angle = 12.0       # angular width at root (deg)
tooth_tip_angle = 20.0        # angular width at tip (deg)
tooth_fillet_radius = 2.6     # R2.6 fillets on the 10 tooth edges
bore_diameter = 14.5          # central through bore

def polar(r, a_deg):
    a = math.radians(a_deg)
    return (r * math.cos(a), r * math.sin(a))

def tooth_profile_points(angle_center):
    """4 corner points of a single tooth trapezoid (root narrower than tip)."""
    half_root = tooth_root_angle / 2.0
    half_tip = tooth_tip_angle / 2.0
    return [
        polar(tooth_root_radius, angle_center - half_root),
        polar(tooth_tip_radius, angle_center - half_tip),
        polar(tooth_tip_radius, angle_center + half_tip),
        polar(tooth_root_radius, angle_center + half_root),
    ]

with BuildPart() as p:
    # --- base disc ---
    with BuildSketch() as s:
        Circle(tooth_root_radius)
    extrude(amount=gear_width / 2.0, both=True)

    # --- 10 trapezoidal teeth, evenly spaced ---
    for i in range(tooth_count):
        ang = i * 360.0 / tooth_count
        with BuildSketch() as ts:
            Polygon(*tooth_profile_points(ang))
        extrude(amount=gear_width / 2.0, both=True)

    # --- fillet all tooth edges (10x R2.6) ---
    fillet(p.part.edges().filter_by(Axis.Z), radius=tooth_fillet_radius)

    # --- central through bore ---
    with Locations((0, 0, 0)):
        Cylinder(radius=bore_diameter / 2.0, height=gear_width * 2, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

part = p.part
